servers.name: postgres-readonly
servers._notes: Three layers enforce read-only: (1) the `--read-only` flag on the MCP server blocks INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE at the server boundary; (2) `permissions/policy.json` pins every write-capable action to the destructive tier so the agent must confirm before even attempting a write; (3) the recommended setup uses a Postgres role whose grants are read-only, so even a server bypass cannot mutate data. All three layers are intentional defense-in-depth.
